{{Quote|To the 212th!|Clone troopers at [[79's/Legends|79's]], declaring a toast to the battalion|<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''212th Attack Battalion''' was a well-known [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] [[Battalion/Legends|unit]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under the leadership of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone marshal commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] [[Civil war|conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As its name suggests, the 212th specialized in invasions, frontal attacks, besiegements and other offensive scenarios. Therefore, they often acted as the main offensive force in major battles, such as spearheading the Republic's deployment on Geonosis, sieging the Umbaran capital city and invading Utapau.

[[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]] assigned to the 212th were distinguished by the [[orange]] markings on their [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II battle armor]]. Composed of smaller units such as [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], the [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]], [[Parjai Squad]], and [[Foxtrot Group/Legends|Foxtrot Group]], the overall 212th Battalion was attached to the [[7th Sky Corps/Legends|7th Sky Corps]].

Throughout the Clone Wars, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the 212th fought in numerous major battles across the galaxy and participated in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Republic attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During this battle, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;the public persona of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious&mdash;issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and sentenced the entire [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to summary execution. Like most of the Clone [[Army/Legends|Army]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody and the 212th troopers obeyed the order, and unsuccessfully attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi. Shortly afterward, the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] under the absolute rule of the newly-anointed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine. The 212th, along with the rest of the remaining clone units, served as the basis of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].

==History==
[[File:Dkobiwanandcody.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Commander Cody and General Kenobi, leaders of the 212th]]
Though commanded by Commander Cody, the 212th Attack Battalion was also led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who developed a friendship with the battalion commander during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The 212th was a well-known and effective battalion which would often be sent to participate in major battles during the Clone Wars. The 212th were often deployed alongside the 501st Attack Battation in missions and battles across the galaxy.

During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], Commander Cody and the 212th aided [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. After being breached unexpectedly by droid forces, it was soon revealed that one of their [[Clone trooper/Legends|brothers]] was a traitor. Cody helped [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] hunt down the traitor who was none other then [[Slick/Legends|Slick]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref> During the Separatist counter attack, the 212th Battalion, along with [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], helped beat back droid forces.

In the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], the battalion, led by Cody, went with Kenobi to aid [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the remainder of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] which had been overrun by droid forces, and later defeated the droid forces under command of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="The Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

[[File:Grievous_Intrigue_212th_Firing.png|thumb|right|300px|Members of the 212th in battle]]
In the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]] helped Kenobi eliminate several [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannons]] to allow ground invasion forces to land. After encountering starved [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]], the squad created a diversion while Kenobi and troopers [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] helped the general destroy the cannons, allowing the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator'' assault ships]] to land and initiate the invasion. Republic troops would later march to the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], liberating the planet from Separatist enslavement.

In the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], General Kenobi, Cody and the 212th were assigned to lead the central charge upon landing. They were the first to land on Geonosis, while the 501st and Ki-Adi-Mundi's battalion were forced to land before reaching their landing zones and rendered them unable to provide support. When Kenobi's gunship crashed behind enemy lines, Cody sent Waxer and Boil to retrieve Kenobi and return with the wounded Jedi Master. The 212th, though vastly outnumbered and forced onto the defensive, lined up their gunships and AT-TEs in a circle formation and used them as gun emplacement platforms to hold the encircling droid forces at bay. The 212th were able to hold out against the Geonosians and their droid forces, albeit with significant casualties, until Generals Skywalker's [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi's]] forces finally arrived with air support.<ref name="LAPR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> Due to sustaining numerous casualties, the 212th would not participate in the following attack on the Geonosian capital.

[[File:212th_clone_trooper.png|thumb|left|180px|A clone trooper of the 212th Attack Battalion in standard armor.]]
In the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], General Kenobi and the 212th spearheaded the Republic ground attack, going straight for the Umbaran capital while the 501st provided support by eliminating enemy supplies. Obi-Wan called on General [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]], who was the interim commander of the 501st in Skywalker's absence, to help aid the siege through various means, such as destroying an Umbaran airbase. While the majority of 212th forces sieged the Umbaran capital itself, Krell ordered a platoon led by Waxer to search the forests for enemy guerrillas disguised in 501st armor. When they fought against the disguised clones, they discovered Krell had lied to them after Captain Rex from the 501st was the first to realize when noticing so many casualties on both sides. Waxer had been fatally wounded but was able to tell Rex that Krell gave the order. The survivors of the platoon joined the 501st in attacking and capturing, at great cost, the traitor, General Krell. Later, the main forces of the 212th successfully took down the capital and dispatched squadrons to destroy the remainder of Separatist forces on Umbara, including the droid battalion which was en route to attack the Umbaran airbase captured by the 501st, effectively ending the Battle of Umbara.

The 212th was sent to Sarrish in an attempt to neutralize Separatist forces on the planet. Although the 212th initially managed to push back the enemy, the Separatist's superiority in numbers and their geographical advantage gradually forced back the 212th forces, instigating heavy casualities in the process. [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], was determined Missing in Action after trying to rescue his squadmates who were pinned down by enemy fire during the battle.

On [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] Kenobi, Commander Cody, and the elite [[Squad Seven (Galactic Republic)|Squad Seven]] breached [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] fortress and secured vital data that began the hunt for [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].

[[File:ROTS-212thReveal.png|thumb|right|300px|Members of the 212th participate in the Battle of Utapau]]
When General Kenobi was tasked with tracking down and eliminating the Separatist Supreme Commander, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], he took the 212th with him. Cody's commandos stormed Grievous's stronghold on the tenth level of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], and kept his droid forces at bay while Kenobi faced the General himself in single combat. The clones would take heavy casualties in the battle due to the superior numbers of droids, but would eventually gain the advantage, and later destroyed all the droid forces stationed on the planet.

Obi-Wan defeated Grievous, and Cody returning Obi Wan's lightsaber which was lost in the battle, the last loyal action taken by the Clone Commander towards his Jedi General before Darth Sidious transmitted [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Cody directed an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] walker to open fire on Kenobi, sending him to his apparent death hundreds of feet below. The clones went on to destroy the remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], and, as per the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] orders, subjugated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Units within the 212th Attack Battalion==
[[File:212th_AT-RT.jpg|thumb|right|180px|An [[AT-RT driver]] of the 212th Attack Battalion.]]

===2nd Airborne Company===
The [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]] made huge drops from high altitudes, with specialized armor and a specialized helmet to do so.

===Ghost Company===
[[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], a reconnaissance squad, notably helped General Kenobi during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], destroying gun emplacements and allowing the main invasion to occur.

===Parjai Squad===
[[Parjai Squad]] is a part of the 2nd Airborne Company.

===Foxtrot Group===
Was an elite clone commando [[Foxtrot Group/Legends|group]] led by [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]]. It was dissolved during the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]].

===Vehicles===
The 212th was known to field [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttles]], [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT gunships]], [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|AT-AP]], [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], all with orange markings.

==Behind the scenes==
The 212th Attack Battalion first appeared in the [[Chapter 22 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|twenty-second chapter]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="CW22">{{CW|22}}</ref> which aired on [[March 22]], [[2005]].<ref name="TV.com">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-xxii-370294|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 2, Episode 2: Chapter XXII}}</ref> It was first identified in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an eight-page reference article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 84|84th issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="Insider 84">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> published by [[IDG Entertainment]] on [[September 26]], 2005.<ref name="Insider 84 Date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> In the [[1983]] [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Star Wars (1977) 68|''Star Wars'' (1977) 68]], [[Fenn Shysa]] mentioned that 212 [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] participated in the [[Mission to Norval II]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Search Begins">[[Star Wars (1977) 68|''Star Wars'' (1977) 68]]</ref>
